text:
nia (partnerships): MercuryLabs asked for a short 'watt headroom' validation tomorrow 11:30am PT. Goal: show perf/W delta across our memcpy patch + DVS (dynamic voltage scaling) vs stock. They only accept anonymized aggregates. Can bench/runtime/kernel confirm minimal artifact set? Link: https://go/redwood/mercury-watt :mag:

omar (eng-runtime): Plan: run a small power-cap sweep (120/140/160W) and two cache states (cold, warm). Will run model `gpt-mini` seq=1024 batch=6. We'll export aggregated metrics + anonymized hotspots.

rebecca (kernel-team): Patch = memcpy micro-opt + relaxed IRQ path. We won't share kallsyms or perf.data. We'll export `hotspots.tsv` with `hotspot_id` and `self_ms`, plus `metrics.csv` and `power.csv`. Include `kernel_build_id` only.

tariq (bench-ops): I'll reserve rack+PDU 11:15-13:00 PT and attach the wall power meter. Bench-bot will tag artifacts with `run_id=mercury-2026-08-04-1` and upload to s3://redwood-partner-exchange/mercury/headroom/. Partner read-only.

mercurylabs-eng: We can provide SoC telemetry (freq,temp) and wall-power at 100ms. Our parser wants headers `ts_ms,power_w,soc_freq_mhz,board_temp_c,run_id`. We'll only accept aggregated outputs with anonymized ids.

omar (eng-runtime): Proposed command:

```
./bench_run --model=gpt-mini --seq=1024 --batch=6 \
  --runs=3 --profiles=stock,memcpy-dvs --limit-watts=140 \
  --sweep-watts=120,140,160 --cache=warm,cold \
  --export-agg=metrics_<run_id>.csv --export-hotspots=hotspots_<run_id>.tsv \
  --export-power=power_<run_id>.csv --agg-hotspots=20
```

rebecca (kernel-team): For perf counters we'll include aggregated intervals (10s): `L2_MISS,memcpy_bytes,ipc,gpu_idle_pct,irq_latency_us`. No raw traces.

mercurylabs-eng: Add `gpu_temp_c` in telemetry please. We'll align header names before the run. Also need `run_id` present to match traces.

tariq (bench-ops): bench-bot will run a 5m validation then full sweep (~45m). I'll ensure `metadata.txt` contains redacted command line and `kernel_build_id` but no hostnames or image IDs. Upload path and ACL confirmed. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/mercury-headroom.

nia (partnerships): Quick privacy note: do not include hostname, IPs, or internal instance IDs. Any joint messaging needs legal sign-off; partner requested a 72h embargo on publication.

bench-bot: Preflight OK. Will tag artifacts with `run_id=mercury-2026-08-04-1` and upload to s3. Will post condensed summary (throughput_tok_s, avg_power_w, efficiency_tok_per_w) + hotspots file here when complete. :robot_face:

rebecca (kernel-team): I'll open a tiny telemetry contract PR with CSV headers (`run_id,timestamp_s,throughput_tok_s,avg_power_w,efficiency_tok_per_w,kv_cache_hit_rate,hotspot_count`) and the hotspots TSV schema (`hotspot_id,self_ms,anon_stack_hash`). No symbol data.

omar (eng-runtime): I'll update the runbook and add sample CSVs. Will ensure `--export-power` emits `ts_ms,power_w,board_temp_c,soc_freq_mhz,run_id`.

mercurylabs-eng: Confirmed, we'll join the Zoom and mute any logs that contain host identifiers. Thanks.

tariq (bench-ops): Run started at 1789014000. Expected wrap ~1789015600. Will post results after completion.
